metadata.notes: No auth gates. App is a local-server Git visualisation tool. All routes are public.

nodes.label: Repository browser — lists folders/repos for a given filesystem path
actions: Type in 'Path' input to change browse directory [input#path]
Type in 'Search' input to filter list [input#search]
Toggle 'Include directories' checkbox [input#include-dirs]
Sort by name button [button 'Sort by name']
Sort by last-changed button [button 'Sort by last changed']
Click 'Previous page' link [link 'Previous page']
Click 'Next page' link [link 'Next page']
Change 'Per page' select [select 'Per page']
Click repository entry to open visualization [link aria-disabled=false]
Click directory entry to navigate into it [link to /browse?path=...]
Click breadcrumb segment to navigate up [link 'Browse <name> directory']
Click 'Clear cache' button [button.btn--danger 'Clear cache']
Click 'Git Truck' header link to github [link 'Git Truck']

nodes.label: Browse page with path error (not found / permission denied / not a folder)
actions: Type in 'Path' input to change directory [input#path]
Type in 'Search' input to filter list [input#search]
Click 'Clear cache' button [button.btn--danger 'Clear cache']
nodes.notes: Shows inline error output beneath path input; directory list is empty

nodes.label: Repo view — loading/analysis in progress (truck animation + progress bar)

nodes.label: Settings modal open — visual preferences overlay
actions: Toggle 'Link size and color option' checkbox [CheckboxWithLabel 'Link size and color option']
Toggle 'Transitions' checkbox [CheckboxWithLabel 'Transitions']
Toggle 'Labels' checkbox [CheckboxWithLabel 'Labels']
Toggle 'Show files with no activity' checkbox [CheckboxWithLabel 'Show files with no activity']
Toggle 'Flatten file tree' checkbox [CheckboxWithLabel 'Flatten file tree']
Toggle 'Show only search matches' checkbox [CheckboxWithLabel 'Show only search matches']
Change 'Pixel render cut-off' number input [input type=number 'Pixel render cut-off']
Click 'Clear cache' button [button.btn--danger 'Clear cache']
Click modal close button / press Escape [button Modal close]
nodes.notes: Headless-UI dialog; settings stored in context (OptionsContext)

nodes.label: Hide files modal open — manage hidden file patterns
actions: Type glob/path pattern in 'Path or glob' input [input name=hide]
Click 'Hide' to add pattern [button 'Hide']
Click trash icon to remove a pattern [button title='Unhide <pattern>']
Click 'Reset' to clear all patterns [button.btn--danger 'Reset']
Click modal close button / press Escape [button Modal close]
nodes.notes: Changes submitted to server on modal close if patterns changed

nodes.label: Group contributors modal — merge contributor identities into groups
actions: Filter ungrouped contributors list [input type=search placeholder='Filter...']
Toggle contributor checkbox to select [CheckboxWithLabel per row]
Click 'Select all' to select all visible contributors [button 'Select all']
Click 'Clear' to deselect all selected [button 'Clear']
Click 'Create new group' to group selected contributors [button 'Create new group']
Click 'Auto group (<N>)' to auto-group by inferred aliases [button 'Auto group']
Change primary alias via group select [select in group card]
Click 'Add contributor' to add selected to existing group [button 'Add contributor']
Click 'Ungroup' icon to dissolve a group [button aria-label='Ungroup']
Click individual alias entry to remove from group [button title='Remove <email>']
Click 'Ungroup all' button to dissolve all groups [button.btn--danger 'Ungroup all']
Click modal close button / press Escape [button Modal close]
nodes.notes: Changes submitted to server on modal close if groups changed; can be opened from Legend or MetricsInspection

nodes.label: Search overlay open — live file/folder search with results dropdown
actions: Type in search field to filter results [input type=search]
Click result item to select object and close search [button result]
Press ArrowDown/ArrowUp to navigate results [keyboard]
Press Escape to close search [keyboard]
Click outside search area to close [pointer outside]
Submit form (Enter) to close search [form onSubmit]
nodes.notes: Ctrl/Cmd+F opens search; shows live count; highlights matching nodes
